title: Galaxy header
description: A sticky black top bar, 54px on phones and 80px on desktop: mark and lowercase wordmark on the left, four plain nav links centred, a search icon and a login link on the right. Links fade to grey on hover; the wordmark dims to 60%. Phones get a search icon and a menu that drops the links below the bar.
notes: the phone menu is a <details> element, so it works without JavaScript
name: galaxy-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set as a lowercase wordmark

props.name: mark
props.description: the mark before the wordmark; a lucide hexagon when empty

props.name: links
props.description: the centred nav items (four on the original)

props.name: action
props.description: the text link on the right (e.g. a login)

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the search icon

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the phone menu button
